Special Cases: Case (i): If the colliding bodies are of equal masses i.e, m1 = m2 = m, then v1 = u2 and v2 = u1 Hence if two bodies of equal masses collide, then, their velocities simply interchange. When u2 = 0, then v1 = 0 and v2 = u1 i.e. when a body collides with another body of the same mass at rest, then, the first body stops and the second body continues with the velocity of the first body. The ejection of the proton with the collision with the neutron is an example of it.
